<function name="GetDepressImage" parent="DImageButton" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Returns whether <page>DImageButton:DepressImage</page> is functional or not.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="enable" type="boolean">`true` to enable image depressing when clicked.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
